fontFamily.primary: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Ubuntu, sans-serif

slideUp.keyframes: @keyframes slideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

slideInRight.keyframes: @keyframes slideInRight { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }

scrollReveal.description: Reveal elements as they scroll into view
